answer: An admission auction holds back the tide of fakes. Each epoch 200 slots are auctioned: applicants bid 40 credits, top 200 win, losers refunded. A winner's bid locks 20 epochs, returns only after honest service; fraud forfeits it. Sybils hunt cheap entry like water in karst cracks, but each fake costs 40 credits: 100 fakes burn 4,000 against 120 income, a 33-epoch payback. An honest agent pays once, keeps its income whole, renews velvet-smooth.
